asset.name: ResponsiveApplicationFrame
asset.description: The complete application frame composing shell, navigation, global commands, overlay hosting, background task status, content boundaries, and every responsive transformation as one adoptable unit.

requires.reason: Frame structure, regions, skip links, and safe areas are the shared shell.
Commands, shortcuts, and the palette are wired once at the frame.
Long-running work has a durable home outside the toast queue.
Content failures are contained without losing the frame.

rationale: Distinct from navigation.app-shell, which is only the structural frame. This is the wired-up version: a scenario adopting it gets navigation, commands, task status, and error containment already connected, which is the difference between a shell and an application.
